title: please provide a solution to turn off Google fonts in HTML
body:
Hi,

From a privacy point of view it would be good to be able to not load fonts from Google.
Could you provide an option to deactivate this?
This is recognized as a privacy breach in Debian. See 
https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=877546

Indirectly, this would also somehow provide a workaround for #1867.

Thanks!
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Web fonts are used in the default stylesheet. If you don't want to use Web fonts you can use a custom stylesheet: .test.adoc ```adoc = Test ``` .plain.css ``` /* empty */ ``` The generated file will be: ```html Test

Test

Last updated 2017-12-19 08:58:55 CET
```

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
Actually, there is a way to turn them off. Just unset the `webfonts` attribute.

```
asciidoctor -a webfonts! document.adoc
```

or

```
= Document Title
:!webfonts:
```

The stylesheet will then fallback to system fonts.

This built-in attribute is documented in the user manual.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
thanks @Mogztter and @mojavelinux for your answers. Next time I'll do a more extensive search in the documentation before forwarding such a bug.
I can thus close this (non)issue. Thanks again.

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body: IMO this should be the default, especially with Google Fonts violating the GDPR.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: A majority of users prefer and rely on this feature, so the default will not be changed. But the attribute provided should be more than sufficient for users to opt out. The default is not being changed.
